name: DomosHQ
description: DomosHQ is Africa’s premier rental trust infrastructure platform. We provide a comprehensive ecosystem where tenants verify utility debts, lock rental terms, and access flexible monthly payments via embedded financing. Landlords benefit from guaranteed payments, automated receipts, and a shared dashboard. Our API enables listing sites and proptechs to embed trust tools, making renting safe, transparent, and predictable across fragmented African markets.
